description:
TIMESTAMPS:

0:00 Intro

0:20 - Talking about a 1v1 battle between Haaland and Van Dijk makes no sense. I don’t understand this story in modern football.

1:35 - They’ve played against each other. It’s a tough task handling Haaland but it’s possible.

2:58 - Darwin Nunez would have scored more goals had he played in this Man City team this season. I hope he’s not comparing himself to Haaland.

4:40 - EPIC RANT - There are no ceilings for some clubs. You don’t like my answer but three clubs in world football can do what they want in world football financially. It’s not possible to deal and compete with clubs like this.

Liverpool manager Jurgen Klopp’s full rant in his embargoed press conference at the ‘three clubs’ in world football who can do what they want financially, as the Reds prepare to face Manchester City on Sunday.
